Numerical Jacobian of a jump model's drift

Source: R/jump_model.R
jm_jacobian.Rd

Central-difference Jacobian of jm_drift(). Used in place of an analytic Jacobian (as hand-derived for SIRD in sird_jacobian()) so that new_jump_model() generalises to arbitrary compartmental structures without per-model algebra. The cost is a small, well- controlled numerical error (step h), validated in the package tests against the analytic SIRD Jacobian.

Usage

jm_jacobian(model, state, parms, h = 1e-06)

Arguments

model

A jump_model.

state, parms

As in sird_drift().

h

Finite-difference step.
